description: This file defines an abstract base class CompletionTransformationBridge that specifies the interface for transforming API requests and responses between different models or APIs within a larger project. It includes abstract methods for request transformation, response transformation, and obtaining response iterators.

classes.name: CompletionTransformationBridge
classes.description: An abstract base class for transforming API requests and responses between different LLM APIs, requiring subclasses to implement methods for request and response transformations, as well as response iteration.
